problem_text:
A regional courier must complete a circuit of five branch offices to collect critical documents.

The travel times between offices are as follows:
* Office P to Q: 66.0 minutes
* Office P to R: 72.9 minutes
* Office P to S: 103.4 minutes
* Office P to T: 105.3 minutes
* Office Q to R: 73.7 minutes
* Office Q to S: 168.7 minutes
* Office Q to T: 135.6 minutes
* Office R to S: 158.2 minutes
* Office R to T: 66.1 minutes
* Office S to T: 145.4 minutes

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel duration for a tour that visits each branch precisely once before returning to the initial office.
